verdict.rationale: Kit provides a well-documented REST API with OAuth flows, webhooks, bulk/async processing, pagination, and an llms.txt for AI-agent consumption, plus official MCP servers (docs MCP and account-action MCP) that let AI agents build against Kit programmatically. However, there is no evidence of official language-specific SDK client libraries (e.g., Python/JS packages) — only raw API reference and MCP tooling. missing for 10: dedicated first-party SDK libraries in specific languages, independent developer corroboration of SDK usage.
